# SD18 deterministic Human Cleric level 18 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Cleric
# level-1..level-17 prepared divine spell-bearing baseline
# (tests/fixtures/rules_core/pf1_human_cleric_level17_sd18_widening_deterministic_input.txt)
# to level 18 as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain
# derived, computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human
# race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic
# ability/feat posture from the level-1 through level-17 fixtures, and the
# same canonical domain selections (Good, Healing), adding only the level
# bump this bounded slice needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Cleric burden surface: no spellbook, no
# spells prepared, no spell slots, no spell DCs, no bonus spells, no domain
# power execution beyond the flat facets already grounded at levels 1-17, no
# domain spell-list contents, and no level-19+ progression. The PF1 CRB
# Cleric class table's level-18 "Special" column is genuinely BLANK
# (verified independently against both d20pfsrd and the Archives of Nethys
# aonprd.com mirror, byte-for-byte agreement): base attack bonus genuinely
# RISES to +13 (18 * 3 / 4 = 13, up from 12 at level 17), both good
# Fortitude/Will genuinely RISE to +11 (18 / 2 + 2 = 11, up from 10 at level
# 17), and poor Reflex genuinely RISES to +6 (18 / 3 = 6, up from 5 at level
# 17). Channel Energy's die count STAYS 9d6 ((18 + 1) / 2 = 9, an
# integer-division coincidence with level 17, the odd-level cadence's next
# rise landing at 19th), and the flat domain spell slot count STAYS 9 (a
# level-18 cleric still casts only up to 9th-level cleric spells, the
# highest cleric spell level in PF1). The Good domain's Touch of Good sacred
# bonus genuinely RISES to 9 (18 / 2 = 9, up from 8 at level 17) via the
# same pre-existing formula, not re-derived.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-cleric-level18
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:cleric:18
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:12
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:17
ability=charisma:14
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:cleric_domain:domain:good
choice=choice:cleric_domain:domain:healing
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:wisdom
